R2 — `resolveSetupOfficialPresetSource` gives precedence to `officialPresetPluginRoot()` (env override path) before falling back to the default source, so `SENTI_OFFICIAL_PRESETS_REPO` remains a local override.

R5 — `resolveSetupOfficialPresetSource` now throws an explicit error with `{ cause }` when official source resolution fails, and discovery paths use this resolver directly instead of silently degrading to base-only candidates.

R7 — Core/base candidates are still returned through existing candidate flow, and plugin-installed preset candidates remain included (`alpha` + official example in test), so adding official source resolution does not remove existing candidate behavior.

R3 — The setup flow now performs base-only selection without resolving official preset state for installation; it only resolves official preset options when a non-base type not already in initial candidates is selected, and `ensureSetupOfficialPresetState` is no-op when `selectedTypes` contains only `base`.

R4 — `setup.js` now resolves official preset source/candidate state when a non-base type requires official presets and passes resolved `officialPresetRoot`/`officialPresetSource` into `ensureSetupOfficialPresetState`. `ensureSetupOfficialPresetState` adds `official-presets` to plugin sources, installs/materializes package when needed, and writes to `.senti/config.json` via `writeProjectConfig`; package entries are created/updated in `installFromSource`, enabling preset registry-based chain resolution (`resolveChain`/`resolveMultiChains`) to succeed from that state.

R6 — `ensureSetupOfficialPresetState` still reads/stores only `.senti/config.json` via `readStoredProjectConfig`/`writeProjectConfig` (not `loadRawConfig`), and the added test explicitly verifies private entries in `config.local.json` are not present in the public config.
